headline: Arm beats Q2 revenue estimates on AI and data center demand
summary: Arm Holdings reported second-quarter revenue that exceeded analyst estimates, supported by continued demand for AI and data center technology.
why: Arm is a critical designer of semiconductor architecture used in nearly all modern smartphones and increasingly in data center processors.

impacts.name: Arm Holdings
impacts.why: Beating revenue estimates in the AI sector is a key growth signal.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong revenue performance in the high-growth AI and data center segments typically drives positive market sentiment for semiconductor firms.
